description:
Part-Time Travel, Full-Time Adventure Through Every Season!
Hey! We're Clint & Jennifer.  As we approach our empty nest years, life has taught us some powerful lessons. We've realized that time is precious and experiences matter way more than things. We've discovered that just like nature's seasons have their own unique beauty, every season of life brings its own adventures.
With a little planning, we want to travel through all four seasons - whether that's hitting the road in our RV to catch spring's wildflowers, paddleboarding or kayaking in the summer in one of our national or state parks, hiking through autumn's golden landscapes, or flying somewhere to discover winter's quiet magic. We believe every season of the year has something amazing to offer. 
Whether you're just starting out or realizing your best travel years could be ahead of you. We hope you'll join us as we show our children(and yours) that adventure doesn't have an expiration date - you just have to GO!
